newsitem.title: UK: Ivory & Sime managing director quits.
newsitem.headline: Ivory & Sime managing director quits.

text.p: Fund manager Ivory & Sime Plc said its managing director Colin Hook had resigned with immediate effect and that chairman David Kinloch will now run the company.
Newspapers reported on Tuesday that Hook had quit amid continued discontent over his management style after several senior managers had recently left the fund management firm.
"We can now proceed in a rather cheerier atmosphere," the Financial Times quoted Kinloch as saying after news of Hook's departure.
Ivory & Sime saw four senior staff set up a new firm last month, the last in a string of management departures.
Kinloch told the Times that Ivory & Sime was doing well and that the firm was not up for sale.
"We are not seeking to receive an offer," he was quoted as saying. "Our investment performance, which is critical, is good and certainly a damn sight better than a lot of our competitors."
